basic_details.job_title: BDL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Notification Out – Apply Online for 134 Graduate, Diploma Apprentice Posts
basic_details.short_information: Bharat Dynamics Limited (BDL) is taking 134 engineering apprentices at its Bhanur unit in Sangareddy district: 78 Graduate Apprentices and 56 Diploma Apprentices. You can apply if you passed your engineering degree or diploma in November 2023, 2024, 2025 or 2026. The training lasts one year. Graduates get Rs.12,300 a month and diploma holders get Rs.10,900 a month. You apply through the NATS portal. The last date to enrol is 7 November 2026, and the last date to apply to BDL is 10 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: About BDL
content_sections.text: Bharat Dynamics Limited is a Government of India enterprise under the Ministry of Defence. These apprentices will train at its Bhanur unit in Sangareddy district, Telangana. The company's registered office is at Gachibowli, Hyderabad.

content_sections.heading: BDL Graduate and Diploma Apprentice Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age limit: As per the Apprenticeship Rules. Year of passing: You must have passed your engineering degree or diploma in Nov-2023, 2024, 2025 or 2026. A degree in Engineering or Technology from a recognised university, or A degree in Engineering or Technology from an institution empowered by an Act of Parliament to grant such degrees. A Diploma in Engineering or Technology in the relevant discipline from a State Council or Board of Technical Education set up by a State Government, or A Diploma in Engineering or Technology in the relevant discipline from a university. You cannot apply if you have already done apprenticeship training under the Apprentices (Amendment) Act 1973, if you are doing it now, or if you have one year or more of work experience. Physical standards are as prescribed in Clause 4 of the Apprenticeship Rules 1992 and any amendments to it. Every applicant must have a valid Aadhaar-seeded bank account. Reservation for SC/ST/OBC/PWD/EWS follows the guidelines under the Apprentices Act. If you claim reservation, you must produce a certificate in the Government standard format. If you cannot, you will be treated as General. BC candidates claiming OBC must bring an OBC certificate in the Government-prescribed format, issued by the Tahsildar. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications received by the notified dates are shortlisted by the marks you scored in the essential qualification, separately for each category: General, SC, ST, OBC, PWD and EWS. Shortlisted candidates are called for certificate verification. Selected candidates receive a Preliminary Offer Letter for joining. This is issued only at the time of certificate verification. BDL will tell shortlisted candidates the dates for certificate verification and joining separately.

content_sections.heading: Important Dates
content_sections.text: The NATS portal takes about 2 to 3 days to generate a registration number. Enrol well before 7 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Training lasts one year under the Apprentices (Amendment) Act 1973, at the BDL Bhanur unit. When the apprenticeship ends, BDL does not have to offer you a job, and you cannot claim one because you finished the training. No TA/DA is paid for attending certificate verification or for joining. BDL does not pay for boarding or lodging.

faq.question: Q1. Which engineering branch has the most apprentice seats at BDL Bhanur?
faq.answer: Mechanical Engineering has the most: 40 Graduate seats and 34 Diploma seats. ECE comes next, with 30 Graduate and 15 Diploma seats.

faq.question: Q2. Are there seats for Civil Engineering graduates?
faq.answer: No. Civil Engineering has no Graduate seats. It has 2 seats for Diploma Apprentices only.

faq.question: Q3. I passed my B.Tech in 2022. Can I apply?
faq.answer: No. The notice is open only to candidates who passed in Nov-2023, 2024, 2025 or 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Can I apply if I have already done an apprenticeship or have work experience?
faq.answer: No. You cannot apply if you have done or are doing apprenticeship training under the Apprentices (Amendment) Act 1973, or if you have one year or more of experience.

faq.question: Q5. Is there a written test?
faq.answer: No. Candidates are shortlisted by their marks in the essential qualification, category-wise. Shortlisted candidates are then called for certificate verification, where selected candidates get a Preliminary Offer Letter.

faq.question: Q6. What happens if I don't enter my percentage on the NATS portal?
faq.answer: Your application will not be considered. You must fill in the "% of marks / CGPA x 10" column and upload your provisional certificate or consolidated marks sheet.

faq.question: Q7. Why does the notice say to enrol early?
faq.answer: The NATS portal takes about 2 to 3 days to generate a registration number, and the last date for enrolment is 7 November 2026, three days before the last date to apply.

faq.question: Q8. Will BDL pay travel costs for certificate verification?
faq.answer: No. No TA/DA is paid for certificate verification or joining, and boarding and lodging costs are not paid either.

faq.question: Q9. Do I need a bank account to apply?
faq.answer: Yes. Every applicant must have a valid Aadhaar-seeded bank account.
